activation_disposition.reason: The suite has exact top-level package output files but no registered spatial TaskSpec, powered rights-cleared donor-level source, external source, or complete transitive environment pin.

registered_lanes.expression_only: Training-partition RNA normalization and HVGs followed by PCA and a frozen classifier where labels exist, or explicitly transductive K-means or Leiden where the endpoint is target-fitted domain discovery.
registered_lanes.simple_spatial_neighbor: A participant- and section-local Squidpy coordinate graph; row-normalized neighbor-mean RNA features combined with own-expression features under a predeclared lambda grid; PCA plus the same frozen or transductive head contract.
registered_lanes.BayesSpace_spot_native: BayesSpace spatial clustering on original spot-level expression and coordinates without H&E. Subspot enhancement is excluded from the primary benchmark.

suite_contract.mandatory_comparison: If a spatial task is activated, every eligible deep or graph model must beat the strongest assay- and topology-matched lane under the same donor folds and endpoint.
suite_contract.unsupported_claim: A target-fitted partition is not an inductive predictor, and a spatially smoothed feature matrix is not an assay-native count model.

scikit_learn.wheel_warning: The registered wheel is platform- and Python-minor-specific and may only be used when the future environment exactly matches its tags.

python_igraph.warning: The pure Python distribution is not a complete native igraph runtime identity. The exact transitive C core or binary artifact remains unresolved.

preprocessing_contract.expression: Record raw-count provenance, library-size normalization, log transform, HVG method and count, scaling, gene identifiers, duplicates, feature order, and panel intersection. Fit learned choices in training participants unless the task is explicitly target-transductive.
preprocessing_contract.PCA: Freeze components, centering, solver, seed, component signs or a sign-invariant comparison, and the training feature roster. A strict lane uses development-fitted loadings for held donors.
preprocessing_contract.spatial_neighbor_features: Freeze graph builder, coordinate source and units, section boundary, K or radius, weighting, row normalization, self-edge policy, m-order, lambda, sparse graph, and feature formula.
preprocessing_contract.clustering: Freeze K-means cluster count and n_init or Leiden graph, resolution, partition type, seed, and mapping. Held labels cannot select these values.
preprocessing_contract.BayesSpace: Freeze feature input, platform lattice, q, d, nrep, gamma, seed, initialization, chain and burn-in policy, and label relabeling. Run and score at original spot and participant units.
preprocessing_contract.missingness: Unmeasured genes, panel absence, filtered features, below-QC observations, permission blocks, and failed joins are not interchangeable zeros.

graph_and_topology_contract.construction: Construct graphs independently inside each authoritative participant and section or core, then combine block-diagonally.
graph_and_topology_contract.multiple_sections: All sections from one participant remain in one outer fold. A technical slide or array containing multiple participants is split by authoritative barcode or tissue-island joins before any graph.
graph_and_topology_contract.held_query: A coordinate graph inside a held donor can be constructed under a locked outcome-blind rule. Refitting PCA, batch correction, feature selection, cluster parameters, or a supervised head on the held cohort is not strict inference.
graph_and_topology_contract.replication: Participants are inferential units. Spots, cells, subspots, graph nodes, edges, clusters, sections, and arrays are not independent participants.

BayesSpace_specific_contract.native_resolution: Spot-based spatial transcriptomics with an appropriate lattice and original spot-level expression is the registered lane.
BayesSpace_specific_contract.single_cell_panels: Do not port the spot-lattice null and neighborhood assumptions to CosMx cells merely because a matrix and coordinates are available.
BayesSpace_specific_contract.enhanceSpatial: Modeled subspots are derivations from original spots. They cannot be treated as observations, independent replicates, or higher-resolution ground truth.
BayesSpace_specific_contract.H&E: Excluded from this baseline suite so it remains transcript-native.

held_donor_capability.supervised_strict_lane: Fit normalization statistics where transferable, HVGs, PCA, classifier, calibration, thresholds, and all tunable graph settings on development participants; transform one held participant at a time with no label access.
held_donor_capability.unsupervised_transductive_lane: PCA, spatial features, and partitions fitted to the target cohort are allowed only for a prespecified transductive domain-discovery endpoint and must be labeled transductive.
held_donor_capability.BayesSpace_lane: BayesSpace is target-fitted spatial clustering, not a native frozen held-donor predictor.
held_donor_capability.selection: All model and cluster selection uses development participants. The held source only scores the locked output.

safe_loading_contract.packages: Acquire only registered artifacts after activation and campaign approval; verify declared sizes and hashes, resolve every transitive package and native-library identity, build without mutable network resolution, and retain lockfiles.
safe_loading_contract.derived_state: Persist arrays and tabular parameters in bounded non-executable formats. Do not accept untrusted pickle, joblib, RDS, or AnnData objects as model state.

runtime_contract.required_probe: After activation and campaign approval only: CPU SLURM Python and R imports, fixed normalization and HVG fixture, participant-blocked graph, PCA transform, K-means and Leiden seeds, BayesSpace compiled-code and chain reproducibility, spot and row-order invariance, no cross-participant edges, no-network rebuild, and output round trip.

terms_and_release_contract.Python_suite: BSD-3-Clause components plus GPL Leiden and igraph components; distribution obligations require review for the assembled environment.
terms_and_release_contract.BayesSpace: MIT plus its package license file, subject to verification of the exact source archive and dependencies.
terms_and_release_contract.data_and_outputs: Release remains conditional on every input matrix, coordinate, annotation, and derived-output right.

source_evidence: Official PyPI release metadata for Scanpy, Squidpy, scikit-learn, leidenalg, and python-igraph plus official Bioconductor metadata for BayesSpace were inspected online on 2026-08-22. No archive, package, code, checkpoint, or dataset was downloaded, installed, or executed.
